steps.label: The baseline
steps.python:
VAL = {'baseline': (12, 10, 18, 110), 'logistic': (21, 12, 9, 108), 'tree': (24, 17, 6, 103)}   # (TP, FP, FN, TN) on 150 validation customers
def metrics(tp, fp, fn, tn):
    p = tp / (tp + fp)
    r = tp / (tp + fn)
    return {'accuracy': (tp + tn) / (tp + fp + fn + tn), 'precision': p, 'recall': r, 'f1': 2 * p * r / (p + r)}
base = metrics(*VAL['baseline'])
print('baseline accuracy:', round(base['accuracy'], 3), ' recall:', round(base['recall'], 2))
# prints: baseline accuracy: 0.813  recall: 0.4
